spans.s:
f. (-ना)
1 The tongue.
2 A woman's girdle or zone.
E.
see रसन.

n. (-नं)
1 Tasting, taste.
2 Sound, noise.
f. (-ना)
1 The tongue.
2 A plant, commonly

Rasan.
3

A woman's girdle, a sort of chain worn round the loins.
4 A plant, (Pæderia foetida.)
E.
रस to sound or taste, aff. युच्; or अश to eat, युच् Uṇādi aff., and रश substituted; also रशना.

m. (-श्मिः)
1 A ray of light.
2 A rein.
3 An eye-lash.
E.
अश to pervade, Uṇādi aff. मि, and रश substituted for the radical.

n. (-लं)
A blaze or stream of light.
E.
रश्मि, and जाल heap.

r. 1st cl. (रसति)
To sound.
r. 10th cl. (रसयति)
1 To taste, to relish.
2 To love, to regard.

m. (-सः)
1 Flavour, taste, as sweet, salt, pungent, bitter, sour, and astringent.
2 Taste, sentiment, emotion, as an object of poetry or composition; eight sentiments are usually enumerated, Śṛṅgāra or love, Hāsya or mirth, Karuṇā or tenderness, Raudra or anger, Vīra or heroism, Bhayānaka or terror, Bībhatsa or disgust, and Adbhuta or surprise: Śānta, tranquillity or content, or Vātsalya, paternal tenderness, is sometimes considered as the ninth.
3 Affection of the mind, passion.
4 Juice, exudation, a fluid, a liquid, or liquified substance.
5

Poison.
6

Semen virile.
7

Water.
8

The primary or essential juice or fluid of the body, whence blood, serum, sweat, &c. are supposed to be engendered; it corresponds best with chyle, but is probably of a fanciful nature.
9 Gum myrrh.
10 Quicksilver, from its being a semi-fluid metal, and according to certain alchymical notions possessed of supernatural power over the juices of the body, &c.
11 A mineral or a metallic salt, as sulphur, borax, talc, blue or green vitriol, &c.; they are however usually called Upa or inferior Rasas.
f. (-सा)
1 The earth.
2 The tongue.
3 A plant, commonly Aknadhi, (Cissampelos hexandra.)
4 A sort of grain, (Panicum italicum.)
5 The frankincense tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)
6 The grape.
7 A medical drug, commonly Kākoli.
E.
रस to taste, to love, &c., aff. अच्.

(ऋ,) राशृ r. 1st and 4th cls. (राशते राश्यते)
To sound.

(ऋ) रासृ r. 1st cl. (रासते)
To sound.

m. (-सः)
1 Confused noise, uproar, hubbub.
2 Sound in general.
3 Speech, discourse.
4 A chain.
5 A festival amongst the cowherds, including songs and dances, especially the circular dance as performed by KṚṢṆA and the Gopīs or cowherdesses.
6 A game played by children.
E.
रस to sound, घञ् aff.

m. (-कः)
Stewed or boiled meat.
E.
रस juice, aff. कन्.

n. (-रः)
A white sublimate or a muriate of mercury, made in close vessels with sulphur, mercury, and common salt; the crystals formed in the first operation are sublimed a second time, which seems to be the only essential difference between this and the preparations called Rasapuṣpa; ut infra.
E.
रस mercury, and कर्प्पूर camphor; from its white colour.

f. (-ला)
1 A low sweet sound.
2 Singing upon intoxication.
E.
रस taste or vinous juice, and कला a note.

n. (-रं)
Camphor.
E.
रस juice, and केसर a filament.

m. (-न्धः)
Gum myrrh.
E.
रस exudation, गन्ध fragrance; also with कन् added, रसगन्धक.

n. (-र्भं)
1 A mineral preparation used as a stibium.
2 Vermilion.
E.
रस quicksilver, and गर्भ embryo.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Born or produced by or in passion, flavour, fluids, &c.
n. (-जं)
Blood.
m. (-जः)
1 Any insect engendered by [] the acetous fermentation of liquids.
2 Molasses, treacle.
E.
रस juice, the primary juice or chyle, &c., and ज born.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Discriminating or acquainted with tastes, sentiments, &c.
m. (-ज्ञः)
1 A poet, a writer who understands the different Rasas or sentiments to be described.
2 An alchymist, one who has obtained a command over the magical properties of mercury.
3 A physician, a medical preparer and administerer of mercurial and chemical compounds.
f. (-ज्ञा)
The tongue.
E.
रस as above, and ज्ञ who or what knows.

f. (-ता)
1 Poetical skill or taste.
2 Knowledge of flavours.
3 Alchymy.
E.
रसज्ञ, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, रसज्ञत्वं.

m. (-ष्ठः)
1 The sweet flavour or taste, sweetness.
2 The sentiment of love.
E.
रस taste or sentiment, and ज्येष्ठ eldest, best.

mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सत्)
1 Speaking, sounding.
2 Tasting, having flavour.
E.
रस to sound, शतृ aff.

n. (-जः)
The blood.
E.
रस chyle, and तेजस् light, strength.

n. (-तु)
Quicksilver.
E.
रस fluid, and धातु metal.

m. (-थः)
Quicksilver.
E.
रस juice, fluid, and नाथ chief.

m. (-कः)
ŚIVA.
E.
रस mercury, नायक leader.

m. (-लिट्)
A dog.
E.
रसना the tongue, and लिह to lick, aff. क्विप्.

f. (-त्तिः)
Loss of taste, flavour, &c.
E.
रस, and निवृत्ति cessation.

f. (-का)
Red arsenic.
E.
रस mercury, नेत्र the eye, कन् added, fem. form.

n. (-ष्पं)
A preparation of mercury, a kind of muriate formed by subliming in close vessels, a mixture of sulphur, mercury, and common salt.
E.
रस mercury, and पुष्प flower.

m. (-लः)
The cocoanut tree.
E.
रस water or juice, and फल the fruit, the nut containing a saccharine fluid.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Interruption or destruction of passion or sentiment, &c.
E.
रस, and भङ्ग a breaking.

n. (-वं)
The blood.
E.
रस chyle, and भव produced.

n. (-स्म)
Calx or oxid of mercury.
E.
रस, and भस्मन ashes.

ind.
Having tasted.
E.
रस to taste, क्त्वाच् aff.

m. (-जः)
Quicksilver.
E.
रस a mineral, and राज sovereign.

ind.
Including a secondary or subsidiary feeling or passion.
E.
रस, and वति aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1

Juicy.
2

Well-flavoured.
3 Tasteful, applied to a composition, &c.
f. (-ती)
A kitchen.
E.
रस juice, flavour, &c., मतुप् aff.

m. (-यः)
Selling juices or liquors, as the juice of the sugar cane, or wine, &c.
E.
रस juice, and विक्रय sale.

m. (-नः)
Borax.
E.
रस a metal, &c., and शोधन purifying; being used as a flux in refining and melting metals.

m. (-द्धः)
An alchymist, an adept: see the next.
E.
रस mercury, and सिद्ध accomplished.

f. (-द्धिः)
The knowledge of alchymy, the possession of peculiar familiarity with mercury, obtained by the performance of chemical operations conjoined with certain mystical and magical rites, and the securing thence to the adept, of happiness, health, and wealth, the power of transmuting metals, and the art of prolonging life.
E.
रस mercury, and सिद्धि accomplishment, especially of some supernatural object.

n. (-रं)
Change or diversion of passion or sentiment.
E.
रस, and अन्तर different.

n. (-रं)
A sort of factitious cinnabar, made with zinc, mercury, blue vitriol, and nitre, fused together; the compound is used as an escharotic.
E.
रस mercury, and सिन्दूर minium.

n. (-नं)
Cinnabar or vermilion.
E.
रस mercury, and स्थान abode.

m. (-नः)
A cock.
E.
रसा the earth, and खन who digs or picks.

n. (-नं)
A sort of collyrium, prepared either with the calx of brass, or with the Amomum anthorrhiza.
E.
रस juice, &c., अञ्जन collyrium.

n. (-लं)
1 Pātāla; the seven infernal regions under the earth, and the residence of the Nāgas, Asuras, Daityas, and other races of monstrous and demoniacal beings, under the various governments of Śeṣa, Bali, and other chiefs: this is not to be confounded with Naraka or Tartarus, the proper hell or abode of guilty mortals after death.
2 The lowest of the seven divisions of Pātāla.
E.
रसा the earth, and तल below, underneath.

n. (-नं)
1 Sucking, suction.
2 Drying, drying up, absorbing.
E.
रसा water or juice, &c., आदान taking.

m. (-रः)
The sun.
E.
रस water, आधार receptacle.

m. (-सः)
Concealment of sentiment, attributing evident emotions to some cause different from the real one.
E.
रस sentiment, and आभास unreal exposition or display.

m. (-शः)
Accession of sentiment or passion.
E.
रस, and अभिनिवेश intentness.

m. (-कः)
A sort of grass, (Saccharum munja.)

n. (-नं)
1 Alchymy, chemistry.
2 The employment of mercury in medicine.
3 A medicine preventing old age, and prolonging life, the Elixir Vitœ of the alchymists.
4

Poison.
5

Butter-milk.
m. (-नः)
1 GARUḌ

An anthelmintic drug commonly Vireng, (Embelia ribes?)
3 An alchymist.
f. (-नी)
A vessel conveying nutrition, a lacteal, an absorbent.
E.
रस juice, quicksilver, &c., and अयन a road, a going, &c.

f. (-ला)
Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)
E.
रसायन juice, abiding, and फला fruit.

m. (-लः)
1 The sugar-cane.
2 The mango tree, (Mangifera Indica.)
3 The jack tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.)
4 The Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)
5 Wheat.
n. (-लं)
1

Frankincense.
2

Gum myrrh.
f. (-ला)
1 The tongue.
2 Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.)
3 A flower, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) []
4 A grape.
5 Curds mixed up with sugar and spices.
E.
रस juice, आङ् before ला to yield, aff. क.

f. (-सा)
A tubular vessel of the body, a nerve, a tendon, &c.

f. (-हा)
A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia.)

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
1 Tasting, relishing.
2 Sensitive, having taste.
m. (-दी)
A bee.
E.
रस flavour, and आस्वादिन् who tastes.

n. (-ह्वः)
Turpentine, resin.
E.
रस juice, and आह्व appellation.

mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं)
1 Flavoured, having taste or flavour.
2 Tasteful, as a composition, &c.
3 Having a taste for poetry, &c.
4

Sentimental.
5

Impassioned.
m. (-कः)
1 A horse.
2 An elephant.
3 A libertine.
f. (-का)
1 Curds with sugar and spice.
2 Molasses, the juice of the sugar-cane.
3 The tongue.
4 A woman's zone or girdle.
E.
रस flavour, sentiment, and ठन् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Gilded, plated, washed or spread with gold, &c.
2

Sounded.
3

Having taste, or flavour, or sentiment.
m. (-तः)
1 The rattling of thunder.
2 Voice, sound in general.
3 Wine, vinous liquor.
E.
रस to sound, aff. क्त, or रस fluid, (metal, &c,) and इतच् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Tasting, having tasted, or having a taste for.
2 Sounding.
E.
रस to have flavour, क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
1 Eating or seizing with a noise or roar.
2 Drinking wine.
E.
रसित, and आशिन् who eats.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
1 Sounding, making a noise.
2 Tasting, relishing.
E.
रस to sound, तृच् aff.

Tasting.
2

Impassioned.
3

Humorous.
E.
रस, and इनि aff.

m. (-नः)
Garlick.
E.
see लसुन, र being changed to ल.

Quicksilver.
2

The philosopher's stone, the touch of which turns iron to gold.
E.
रस a mineral, and इन्द्र best.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Production of taste or flavour.
2 Development of passion or sentiment.
3 Generation of the vital fluids.
E.
रस, and उत्पत्ति production.

m. (-नः)
A kind of garlick, (Allium ascalonicum.)
E.
रस flavour, taste, ऊन to be less or deficient, aff. अच्, being supposed to contain in the leaves, stalk, root, &c., every flavour except sourness; also with कन् added, रसोनक.

n. (-लं)
A pearl.
E.
रस water, and उपला a stone.

n. (-लं)
Thing, substance.
E.
रस juice, &c., and नक् Uṇādi aff.

f. (-स्ना)
1 A plant, (Mimosa octandra.)
2 Another plant, (the serpent ophioxylon ?)
3 A sort of perfume.
E.
स्स to sound, नक् Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Juicy.
n. (-स्यं)
Blood.
E.
रस chyle, यत् aff.

m. (-शिः)
1 A heap, a quantity.
2 A sign of the zodiac.
3 Arithmetical or algebraic quantity.
4 A part and its divisor, or numerator and denominator.
5 A congeries of number or quantity.
E.
अश to pervade, इण् Uṇādi aff. and रुट् initial augment; or रश to sound, with the same aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Heaped, accumulated.
2 Computed, summed either by arithmetic or algebra.
E.
राशि, and गत gone to.

n. (-क्रं)
The zodiac.
E.
राशि a sign, and चक्र a wheel or circle.

m. (-गः)
A fraction.
E.
राशि, and भाग a part.

m. (-गः)
Passage of a planet through a sign of the zodiac.
E.
राशि, भोग enjoyment.

n. (-णं)
Heaping, piling, gathering.
E.
राशि, and करण making, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Heaped, piled, gathered.
E.
राशि, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Heaped, piled.
E.
राशि, and भूत become, च्चि aug.

mn. (-ष्ट्रः-ष्ट्रं)
1 An inhabited country or realm, a region.
2 Any public calamity, as plague, famine, &c.
E.
राज to shine or govern, aff. ष्ट्रन्.

m. (-सी)
An inhabitant of any civilized country.
E.
राष्ट्र a district, and निवासिन a dweller.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging to or inhabiting a country.
f. (-का)
A prickly sort of night-shade, (Solanum jacquini.)
E.
राष्ट्र a country, and ठन् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Of or belonging to a kingdom, produced or born in it, &c.
E.
राष्ट्र a region, and घ aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Belonging or relating to a region or realm.
m. (-यः)
A king's brother-in-law, (in theatrical language.)
E.
राष्ट्र a region, छ aff.

m. (-भः)
An ass.
f. (-भी)
The she ass.
E.
रास to sound, अभच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Grey or light-brown, ass-grey.
E.
रासभ and धूसर grey.

f. (-नी)
Arabian jasmine.
E.
रासभ an ass, वदि to praise, aff. णिनि.

f. (-त्रा)
A festival in honour of KṚṢṆA on the full moon of Kārttika.
E.
रास, and यात्रा festival.

m. (-सः)
1 An assembly, a company, a party.
2 A game or festival peculiar to the cowherds: see रास.
3 Love, desire, the passion or sentiment.
4 Alchymy: see रससिद्धि.
5 The sixth night after delivery, on which the family and friends sit up all night.
6 Sport, mirth, pastime.
7 Any festival or holiday.
E.
रास noise, &c., and रस flavour, taste.
